summary: agent-ctx: extended the built-in --test self-test with a regression check that dump() reflects live repo state and ignores a stale cached repo_map.md. agent-kb: fixed test_backend.py to use an isolated temp DB (it was writing real records into ~/.agent-kb/kb.db on every run), added a regression test that the mcp command stays removed, and made verify_kb.py clean up its own smoke-test record instead of leaving it in the real DB.
author: devhax

summary: Rebuilt agent-ctx's repo map as a ranked orientation layer: git ls-files for visibility (fixes negation/path/glob ignore bugs), import-graph in-degree + churn + entry-point ranking, real signatures and line numbers via ast.unparse, module docstrings, shebang sniffing for extensionless scripts, character budget replacing the silent 150-file cap, and a working-state block (branch/uncommitted/recent commits) in dump. get_git_branch no longer fabricates 'main'. Self-test extended and mutation-checked.
author: devhax

summary: Validated the ranked map against titirek (162-file Next.js app) and fixed what only a real repo exposed: tsconfig/jsconfig path-alias resolution (401 alias vs 26 relative imports there; graph went from ~26 to 464 edges), file-system route entry points instead of mislabelled index.ts barrels, export default/export const symbol capture, deduped+dir-qualified importer labels, in-degree>=2 files shown even without symbols, and a single priority-ordered dump budget (memory > decisions > map) with the collapsed tail reserved. Corrected a memory.md claim that titirek falsified.
author: devhax

summary: Measured budget cost/return (tokens not time; saturation is O(repo size): titirek 27.6k chars vs 4.3MB/1.09M tokens uncapped on a 12k-file repo). Added --budget default/large/immense + AGENT_CTX_BUDGET to map and dump with thirds allocation. Replaced positional clipping with structural trimming: all ADR titles always shown with bodies expanded newest-first; memory trimmed by section priority with the top section truncated rather than dropped. Deleted clip_lines.
